description: This pretty Devon based village is located near the confluence of the rivers Wolf and Lyd and also the border with Cornwall. This walk from the village takes you along the Two Castles Trail and the West Devon Way to visit the neighbouring village of Lydford. Here you can visit the wonderful Lydford Gorge, one of the walking highlights of the area. Please scroll down for the full list of walks near and around Lifton. The detailed maps below also show a range of footpaths, bridleways and cycle paths in the area.
